record.question: Maintaining good supplier relationships should be important to all project managers. A good buyer-seller relationship is a partnership that results in a win-win situation that nurtures both parties. Which of the following is both a short and long-term benefit of treating a supplier with courtesy, honesty, and fairness?
options: There is no need to have formal contracts in place
Delivery of quality products and services at the best price
The buyer can delay the payments without jeopardizing the relationship
The supplier can charge a price higher than the market price
